semantics: Stage elapsed timings include scheduling and are not CPU timings. The public profile removed each queue span's stage label. Counter windows are therefore combined without labeling them commit, flush or poll. Union the monotonic overflow-count half-open intervals [before.overflow,after.overflow), not elapsed-time durations; nested windows count each observed overflow increment at most once. Zero-overflow fraction is null. All original attempts retained; no rescoring or new workload execution.
limits: These counters establish synchronous main-thread stall exposure and overflow increments inside retained windows, not the unique OS/SQLite cause or the effects of a proposed architecture. The current final data do not justify carrying the older D3 near-100% commit share forward. Fixed-bounded decoupling must measure downstream backpressure and end-to-end completion without hiding loss.

public_redaction.meaning: Withheld host metadata and historical branch labels are null, not zero. Original artifact digests refer to retained local pre-redaction evidence. Measured workload results and failed attempts are unchanged.
